counterevidence: Mill formation is strongly associated with successful trajectories in the available training logs: winning games contain 540 inferred mill actions in 2,550 learner steps. Removing all mill shaping could therefore discard useful signal.
The training logs do not persist a step-level mill-formation by Malom-downgrade cross-tab. The held-out overlap cannot be projected back onto all training actions.

Movement and flying actions also receive heuristic-delta shaping, and every action receives delayed outcome credit. The unconditional mill bonus is not the only possible explanation outside placement.
The full-oracle audit identifies better actions but does not load the candidate, inspect logits, or prove which reward component caused the learned ranking.
The 19 states are outcome-selected from one checkpoint and one seed. Their frequencies are not estimates for arbitrary play.

hypotheses.hypothesis: The legacy unconditional mill bonus can reinforce premature mill closure even when the complete turn loses corrected Malom value.
hypotheses.support: All 16 capture-bearing first downgrades require a different primary action to preserve WDL; no preserving or full-best alternative captures. The trainer awards +0.25 for every newly formed mill while the immediate Malom reward weight is zero.
hypotheses.test: Add an explicit reward mode that pays the existing mill bonus only when corrected complete-turn Malom quality is value-preserving. Compare it with the unchanged legacy mode under identical seeds, data, curriculum and evaluator.

hypotheses.hypothesis: The placement failures are the cleanest reward-conflict cell.
hypotheses.support: Four of six placement downgrades form mills and capture within two to five post-prefix plies. In placement, Sentinel and heuristic-delta rewards are gated off, Malom reward is zero, and the immediate positive shaping on those turns is the mill bonus.
hypotheses.test: Before any long run, use fixed placement states to verify that legacy mode rewards these downgrades and the new mode suppresses only the contradictory bonus.

hypotheses.hypothesis: A surgical Malom gate is safer than globally removing mill shaping.
hypotheses.support: Winning trajectories have a much higher inferred mill-action rate than losing or drawn trajectories, while every audited first downgrade has at least one non-capturing value-preserving alternative.
hypotheses.test: Freeze a legacy-unconditional versus Malom-preserving-only ablation. Log formed-mill count, mill reward, Malom downgrade count and their intersection per game and phase.

next_validation: Add explicit, backward-compatible mill-bonus modes and fail closed on missing Malom quality when the preserving-only mode is selected.
Add per-game and per-phase observability for formed mills, awarded mill bonuses, Malom downgrades and formed-mill by downgrade intersections.
Run focused reward tests and a no-update integration probe on the 19 frozen states without loading the retained candidate.
Freeze one successor smoke and a matched legacy ablation with identical seeds, hyperparameters, data identities, baseline and phase-specific metrics before authorising retained training.
Audit conversion progress separately for the four favourable-colour counterpart draws; coarse WDL and this alternative audit do not explain live-rule draws.
observed_facts: The full corrected Malom inventory exactly matches the local legal-turn inventory at all 19 first-downgrade states.
The committed candidate action is not full-oracle best in any of the 19 states.
All 19 states have at least one value-preserving alternative and at least one strictly better full-oracle alternative.
None of the 351 value-preserving alternatives and none of the 347 full-oracle-best alternatives contains a capture.
The 16 capture-bearing downgrades have no value-preserving alternative with the same from/to primary action and a different capture target.
The resulting classifications are 16 primary-action-or-mill-timing errors and three non-capturing primary-action errors; there are zero wrong-capture-target classifications.
The trainer source blob is identical at the managed plan commit, final segment commit and current audit commit.

training_log_context.coverage_note: Accepted train logs cover games 1-3000 and 3201-5000; games 3001-3200 are absent after the documented segment-13 recovery.
training_log_context.derivation: mill actions equal steps times (reward_total_mean - reward_sentinel_mean - reward_heuristic_mean - reward_retro_mean) divided by 0.25; maximum integer-rounding residual is below 3e-14
